title: Genuine Dyson Extension Hose - Don’t Buy. Worthless
text: Genuine Dyson Extension Hose - Don’t Buy. Worthless. Perhaps it is good for a car. It terrible for home use. Unacceptable and very awkward to use. Easier to bend your back before purchase.

product_metadata.title: Dyson Genuine Dyson Extension Hose, 917250-04
features: For use with the following Dyson vacuums: DC59 cord-free stick, V6 handhelds, V6 cord-free stick, DC65 upright, Ball Multi Floor, Ball Multi Floor 2, Ball Animal, Ball Animal 2, Cinetic Big Ball Animal, Cinetic Big Ball Animal+Allergy, and Ball Multi Floor canister
NOTE: Refer the User Guide before use
description: This is not a replacement hose, it is an extender. This part is designed to be compatible with an existing Dyson hose. This fits Dyson hoses on the following models: DC16, 24, 31, 34, 35, 44, 47, 50, 56, 58, 59.
